reason: The application overstates the registered conclusion of lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation. That external gives an error-improved map with the numerical defect and unit bounds and explicitly preserves only bijectivity (when present), source, target corner, and amplification form; it does not state that the extended-inclusion tag is preserved or that v_1 is an extended d_1-inclusion. Under def-maincb-reset-state the tag is separately supplied datum, and under def-maincb-raw-call a recorded defect number alone asserts no inclusion property. Thus node 1.6's phrase 'carrying the inclusion tag' is unsupported, so the claimed extended W.c0_cb*epsilon-inclusion cannot follow from this application.
